It is said that when children place these stones under their pillows, it helps them sleep without nightmares. ==Acquisition== * [[Factions]] ** [[Shiro'ken]] (except in [[Imperial Sanctum]]) ''Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found [[Talk:Soul Stone#Drop research|here]].'' ===Farming=== ==== [[Raisu Palace (explorable)]] ==== [[File:Soul Stone farming (Raisu Palace explorable).jpg|250px]] [[Spirit spammer|Spirit spam]] along the route as indicated by the map. You can easily kill groups without [[Shiro'ken Elementalist]]s. The [[spawn]] near [[Silent Ancient Onata]] varies and may not be defeatable.
